description:
Onboard a new AI agent in one step: Solana and EVM wallets it controls, $1.00 of Toolbooth credit, an ERC-8004 identity on Base, <name>.toolbooth.eth, and MCP config. Pass the new agent's solanaAddress, evmAddress, apiKeyHash (hex SHA-256 of a fresh tb_live_ key you generated) and proofs: sign "toolbooth.io spawn_agent
name:<name>
solana:<solanaAddress>
evm:<evmAddress lowercase>
key:<apiKeyHash>
issued:<ISO-8601 now>" with the Solana key (Ed25519, base64 → solanaSig) and the EVM key (EIP-191 personal_sign, hex → evmSig). Or set generateKeys=true to receive new keys once in the result (discouraged: secrets pass through this conversation). Costs $2.00 USDC per call.

apiKeyHash.description: Hex SHA-256 of the agent's new tb_live_ API key

description.description: Public one-line description of the agent

endpoint.description: Optional https endpoint for the agent (e.g. its MCP server)

generateKeys.description: Have Toolbooth generate the keys and return them once (discouraged)

name: spawn_agent
title: Spawn an agent
